newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end slightly higher but funds stay away.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end slightly higher but funds stay away.

text.p: UK blue chips ended a lethargic session slightly higher on Thursday as institutional investors continued to steer clear of a market currently plagued by a host of uncertainties.
"It's been another nothing day. The funds are just sitting on their cash," the head of trading at a large brokerage said.
"We need some good news to break us out of this stupor but I can't see anything at the moment that will bring back the buyers."
The FTSE 100 index ended 4.3 points higher to 4,298.9 after trading in a narrow 20-point range during the session.
